entities.summary: Grigori Georgievich Denisenko is a Russian professional ice hockey winger who plays for Ak Bars Kazan of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected in the first round, 15th overall, by the Florida Panthers in the 2018 NHL entry draft. He played two seasons with Lokomotiv Yaroslavl of the Kontinental Hockey League before moving to North America in 2020, and made his NHL debut in 2021.
